legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract is freely assignable by the Assignee, and any such assignment shall not require the consent of the Seller or the Assignor.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor and the Assignee shall indemnify and hold harmless the Seller against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from any breach of this Assignment of Contract.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment of Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment of Contract shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for ensuring that all closing obligations are met, including the payment of all closing costs and fees.
